modules.name: Start Here: Understanding the FDE Role
modules.name_zh: 从这里开始：理解 FDE 角色
modules.purpose: Give readers who don't yet know what an FDE is a map before any engineering: what the role is accountable for, how it differs from neighboring roles, and which module builds the capability each stage of FDE delivery needs. Orientation only, no engineering detail.

lessons.label_zh: 第 3 课 · FDE 交付生命周期与手册地图

modules.name: AI-Assisted Development & Software Systems Foundations
modules.name_zh: AI 辅助开发与软件系统基础
modules.purpose: Build a mental model of modern software systems for beginners or technically rusty learners, and enable them to read, run, modify, debug, and deploy code with AI coding tools. The focus is system understanding rather than syntax memorization.

lessons.label: Lesson 2 · How web apps run
lessons.label_zh: Lesson 2 · Web 应用如何运行

modules.name: AI Application Engineering
modules.purpose: Turn LLMs from “chat tools” into verifiable, integrable application capabilities. Use a Tutor / Customer Support RAG case to build foundations in prompting, RAG, tool calling, evaluation, and guardrails.

modules.name: Agent Engineering
modules.purpose: Define an agent as a job with real boundaries, give it reusable skills backed by code where needed, choose between a workflow, a single agent and multiple agents, and make its state, long-running work and failures manageable. An agent is not simply a prompt, and more agents are not automatically better.

lessons.label: 3. Workflows, Single Agents and Multi-Agent Systems

modules.name: Enterprise Integration & Production AI
modules.purpose: Teach learners that real customer environments involve data, APIs, permissions, security, deployment, observability, cost, and reliability beyond prompts/agents, and develop judgment about when deeper engineering is required.

lessons.label: Lesson 1 · External APIs, MCP & Connector Design
Lesson 3 · Real-World Data: Quality, Freshness, Provenance & Entity Resolution
Lesson 5 · Deployment, CI/CD, Observability & Production Readiness

modules.name: FDE Discovery, Consulting & Delivery
modules.purpose: Train the core capabilities that distinguish FDEs from typical AI Engineers: entering ambiguous customer environments, finding the real problem, defining outcomes, managing scope, making technical/business trade-offs, and driving pilots, acceptance, handoff, and productization.

lessons.label: Lesson 1 · The FDE Role & End-to-End Delivery Lifecycle
Lesson 3 · As-Is / To-Be Workflow Mapping & Requirement Decomposition
Lesson 4 · Scope, PRD/SOW, Acceptance Criteria & Non-Goals
Lesson 5 · Solution Architecture: Choose the Simplest Architecture That Works

modules.name: Four Representative FDE Use-Case Archetypes
modules.name_zh: 四个代表性 FDE 用例原型
modules.purpose: Use four realistic cases of increasing complexity to demonstrate the same FDE method repeatedly. Industry is the context; the goal is to understand why different business problems require different technical depth.

lessons.label: Lesson 1 · Tutor / support RAG
lessons.label_zh: Lesson 1 · 辅导 / 客服 RAG

modules.name: FDE End-to-End Practicum
modules.purpose: Learners choose an approved customer-style use case and complete a full FDE delivery from Discovery through Release/Handoff. This is the core job-search portfolio module and is not tied to a fixed number of weeks.
